cards.title: Homes and Living Spaces
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of homes and living spaces.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo in as much detail as possible.
Tell me about the home you lived in when you were younger. What was it like, and how does it compare to where you live now?
What type of home would you like to live in when you are older, and why would you choose that particular style?
Some people believe that having an outside space or garden at home is essential for quality of life. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
How do you think homes and living spaces might change in the next twenty years, considering factors like technology and environmental concerns?
In your opinion, what are the most important features to consider when choosing a home?
Do you have a question for me about homes or living spaces?

cards.title: Travel and Tourism
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of travel and tourism.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, focusing on what you can see and the atmosphere it suggests.
Where did you spend your school holidays last year, and what made that particular trip memorable or special?
If you could travel anywhere in the world for a holiday, where would you choose and what aspects of that destination appeal to you most?
Some people argue that international tourism has more negative effects than positive ones on local communities. What are your views on this?
Compare and contrast the experience of visiting a foreign country versus exploring your own country as a tourist.
What advice would you give to someone who is planning their first trip to a country with a very different culture from their own?
Do you have a question for me about travel or tourism?

cards.title: Education and Learning
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of education and learning.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, paying attention to the activities and relationships you can observe.
Tell me about a typical school day for you, including both academic subjects and any extra-curricular activities you participate in.
In what ways do you think education could be improved for students your age, considering both curriculum and teaching methods?
Some educators believe that homework is essential for academic success, while others argue it causes unnecessary stress. What is your perspective?
How do you think classrooms and learning environments might change in the next ten years, particularly with advances in technology?
Compare the benefits of learning in a traditional classroom setting versus learning through online platforms.
Do you have a question for me about education or learning?

cards.title: Working Life and Careers
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of working life and careers.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, focusing on the people, their activities, and the work environment you can see.
Have you ever done any work experience, volunteering, or helped in a family business? What did you learn from that experience?
What career or job would you like to pursue in the future, and what factors have influenced this choice?
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of working from home compared to working in a traditional office environment.
Do you think young people should gain work experience before attending university, and why might this be beneficial or problematic?
How do you think the job market and types of careers available might change in the next twenty years?
Do you have a question for me about working life or careers?

cards.title: Myself and Identity
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of yourself and identity.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo in as much detail as possible, including the people and what they appear to be doing.
Tell me about a typical day in your life. What routines are important to you, and why?
How would you describe your personality to someone who has just met you, and which qualities would you like to develop?
Some people say teenagers should be independent as early as possible. To what extent do you agree?
How do you think young people's lifestyles might change over the next ten years?
What advice would you give to a student moving to a new school who wants to make a good first impression?
Do you have a question for me about daily life or identity?

cards.title: Friends and Family
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of friends and family.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, focusing on the people, their relationships, and the mood of the scene.
Tell me about a family celebration or a time you spent with friends that you remember well. What made it special?
How do friendships change as people get older, and what do you value most in a close friend?
Some people believe family is more important than friends. What is your view?
Compare spending free time with family and spending it with friends. What are the advantages of each?
How might family life change in the future as more people live and work in different countries?
Do you have a question for me about friends or family?

cards.title: Hobbies and Leisure
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of hobbies and leisure.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, including the activity, the setting, and how the people seem to feel.
What do you like doing in your free time, and how did you first become interested in that hobby?
If you could take up a new hobby next year, what would you choose and why?
Some people think young people spend too much free time on screens. Do you agree or disagree?
Compare indoor hobbies with outdoor activities. What are the benefits of each?
How might leisure activities change as technology develops?
Do you have a question for me about hobbies or free time?

cards.title: Equality

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo and explain what idea or situation it might represent.

What does equality mean to you in school, at work, or in society?
Some people argue that everyone already has equal opportunities. To what extent do you agree?
What practical steps could schools and governments take to make society fairer?
How do you think attitudes to equality might change in the next twenty years?
Do you have a question for me about equality or fairness?

cards.title: The Environment
cards.examiner_intro: We are now going to complete the final task, Task 3. Look at the picture. We are going to discuss the picture and the topic of the environment.

examiner_prompts.spoken: Describe the photo, focusing on the setting, the people, and any environmental details you notice.
What do you personally do to help the environment, and how easy or difficult is that in your daily life?
Which environmental problem do you think is the most urgent, and why?
Some people say individuals cannot make a difference compared with large companies. What is your view?
Compare the environmental impact of travelling by car with travelling by public transport or bicycle.
How might towns and cities look different in twenty years if they become more environmentally friendly?
Do you have a question for me about the environment?

How do you usually get news or entertainment, and which sources do you trust the most?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media for young people?
Some people believe traditional newspapers and television are no longer necessary. Do you agree?
How can students check whether a news story is reliable?
How do you think the media might change in the next ten years?

cards.title: Technology

What advice would you give to someone who spends too much time online?

cards.title: Sport

What advice would you give to a friend who wants to become fitter but does not enjoy sport?

cards.title: Food and Culture
